title: 藥理學與藥學
intro: 藥物動力學、各類藥物機轉、藥物交互作用與臨床藥學。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Pharmacokinetics, drug-class mechanisms, interactions and clinical pharmacy. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.

procedures.title: 不同藥盒，相同成分：出院藥物核對
procedures.titleEn: Different boxes, the same ingredient: discharge reconciliation
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據與系統安全
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence and system safety
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：72 歲女性出院後帶來兩份藥單及自購感冒產品，女兒依商品名分成三種不同藥。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 72-year-old woman brings two discharge lists and an over-the-counter cold product; her daughter sorts them by brand name.

stages.title: 釐清問題
stages.evidence: 兩張藥單品牌不同，其中一個有效成分名稱相同；尚未確認實際服用情形。
stages.evidenceEn: Two lists use different brands but share an active ingredient; actual use is not yet known.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 核對成分、劑型與實際使用
choices.en: Verify ingredients, formulation and actual use

choices.zh: 依不同商品名計為互不相關的藥物
choices.en: Count different brands as unrelated medicines

stages.reason: 商品名不保證成分不同。核對需區分紙上處方、已停用項目與真正服用者。
stages.reasonEn: Brand names do not establish different ingredients. Reconciliation distinguishes listed, discontinued and actually used products.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「依不同商品名計為互不相關的藥物」。商品名不保證成分不同。核對需區分紙上處方、已停用項目與真正服用者。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Count different brands as unrelated medicines. Brand names do not establish different ingredients. Reconciliation distinguishes listed, discontinued and actually used products.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 女兒說一盒只放在櫃中，另一盒每天使用；感冒產品則昨晚開始。
stages.evidenceEn: One box is stored unused, another is used daily, and the cold product began last night.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 因家中持有三盒就記成同時服用三種
choices.en: Record possession of three boxes as simultaneous use

choices.zh: 將開始、停用與未使用分別放入時間線
choices.en: Record starts, stops and unused products separately

stages.reason: 持有不等於暴露；時間線可避免誇大或漏掉實際重複。
stages.reasonEn: Possession is not exposure; a timeline avoids overstating or missing duplication.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「因家中持有三盒就記成同時服用三種」。持有不等於暴露；時間線可避免誇大或漏掉實際重複。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Record possession of three boxes as simultaneous use. Possession is not exposure; a timeline avoids overstating or missing duplication.

stages.title: 比較解釋
stages.evidence: 感冒產品含多種成分，包裝上的用途與平時止痛藥不同。
stages.evidenceEn: The cold product combines ingredients and advertises a different use from the usual pain medicine.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 逐項核對並請藥師評估重複
choices.en: Compare ingredients and request duplication review

choices.zh: 用途不同就排除成分重複的可能
choices.en: Exclude overlap because the advertised purposes differ

stages.reason: 複方產品的用途標籤不能取代成分核對；本案例不自行計算或更改用量。
stages.reasonEn: A combination product’s advertised purpose cannot replace ingredient review; this case does not calculate or alter doses.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「用途不同就排除成分重複的可能」。複方產品的用途標籤不能取代成分核對；本案例不自行計算或更改用量。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Exclude overlap because the advertised purposes differ. A combination product’s advertised purpose cannot replace ingredient review; this case does not calculate or alter doses.

stages.title: 規畫再評估
stages.evidence: 團隊完成核對後，女兒仍把舊藥單拍照傳給另一照顧者。
stages.evidenceEn: After reconciliation, the daughter sends an old list to another caregiver.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 只要醫院系統正確，家中版本無需處理
choices.en: Ignore home versions once the hospital record is correct

choices.zh: 確認唯一現行藥單版本並請照顧者回述
choices.en: Confirm the current list version and ask for teach-back

stages.reason: 用藥安全跨越照顧場域；回述可查出版本混用及尚未理解之處。
stages.reasonEn: Safety spans care settings; teach-back can reveal mixed versions and unresolved understanding.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「只要醫院系統正確，家中版本無需處理」。用藥安全跨越照顧場域；回述可查出版本混用及尚未理解之處。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Ignore home versions once the hospital record is correct. Safety spans care settings; teach-back can reveal mixed versions and unresolved understanding.

stages.title: 交班與回饋
stages.evidence: 交班已核實的成分清單、實際服用時間、未解重複疑慮、現行版本及負責藥師。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over verified ingredients, actual timing, unresolved duplication, the current list version and responsible pharmacist.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 交付本案證據、未解問題及具名接手者
choices.en: Transfer the evidence, unresolved questions and named follow-up owner

choices.zh: 只交付最終結論，省略限制與後續負責者
choices.en: Transfer only the conclusion without limitations or follow-up ownership

stages.reason: 交班需保留：交班已核實的成分清單、實際服用時間、未解重複疑慮、現行版本及負責藥師。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over verified ingredients, actual timing, unresolved duplication, the current list version and responsible pharmacist.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「只交付最終結論，省略限制與後續負責者」。交班需保留：交班已核實的成分清單、實際服用時間、未解重複疑慮、現行版本及負責藥師。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Transfer only the conclusion without limitations or follow-up ownership. The handover must preserve: Hand over verified ingredients, actual timing, unresolved duplication, the current list version and responsible pharmacist.

learningBoundary.zh: 用於教學推理；數據為虛構，不提供個人處方、真實疫情判定或臨床驗證預測。
learningBoundary.en: For reasoning education; fictional data do not provide prescriptions, real outbreak determinations or clinically validated predictions.

procedures.title: 突然嗜睡：處方、成藥與酒精一起核對
procedures.titleEn: New drowsiness: reconcile prescriptions, OTC products and alcohol
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據與系統安全
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence and system safety
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：46 歲輪班工作者在使用原有睡眠藥期間加入過敏成藥，隔日覺得反應比平時慢。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 46-year-old shift worker adds an allergy product while using a prescribed sleep medicine and notices slower reactions.

stages.title: 釐清問題
stages.evidence: 病人只提供兩個商品名，尚無成分、服用時間與睡眠紀錄。
stages.evidenceEn: Only two brand names are available, without ingredients, timing or sleep records.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 直接用商品名稱相似程度判定交互作用
choices.en: Judge interactions from similarity of brand names

choices.zh: 先取得完整產品與暴露時間資料
choices.en: Obtain complete product and exposure timing information

stages.reason: 判讀交互作用需要實際成分及時間；相似或不同名稱都不足以推定。
stages.reasonEn: Interaction assessment needs ingredients and timing; name similarity or difference is insufficient.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「直接用商品名稱相似程度判定交互作用」。判讀交互作用需要實際成分及時間；相似或不同名稱都不足以推定。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Judge interactions from similarity of brand names. Interaction assessment needs ingredients and timing; name similarity or difference is insufficient.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 確認其中兩種產品都有鎮靜警語；當晚另外喝酒。
stages.evidenceEn: Both products carry sedation warnings, and alcohol was also consumed that evening.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 將加成影響列為疑慮並安排專業評估
choices.en: Flag possible additive effects for professional assessment

choices.zh: 各產品可單獨購得，所以併用必然安全
choices.en: Assume combined use is safe because each product is available separately

stages.reason: 個別產品的可取得性不代表併用安全；藥物與酒精的影響需一起考量。
stages.reasonEn: Availability of individual products does not establish safety in combination; alcohol also matters.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「各產品可單獨購得，所以併用必然安全」。個別產品的可取得性不代表併用安全；藥物與酒精的影響需一起考量。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Assume combined use is safe because each product is available separately. Availability of individual products does not establish safety in combination; alcohol also matters.

stages.title: 比較解釋
stages.evidence: 新的訪談顯示睡眠不足，但家人說今天已難以喚醒。
stages.evidenceEn: Sleep deprivation is identified, but family now reports difficulty waking the person.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 有睡眠不足就先觀察到隔日再說
choices.en: Wait until the next day because sleep deprivation is present

choices.zh: 優先緊急評估反應異常
choices.en: Prioritise urgent assessment of reduced responsiveness

stages.reason: 可能的解釋不會消除警訊；反應異常不能只歸因疲倦，也不能由模擬器排除危險。
stages.reasonEn: A possible explanation does not remove a red flag; reduced responsiveness cannot be dismissed as fatigue or cleared by a simulator.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「有睡眠不足就先觀察到隔日再說」。可能的解釋不會消除警訊；反應異常不能只歸因疲倦，也不能由模擬器排除危險。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Wait until the next day because sleep deprivation is present. A possible explanation does not remove a red flag; reduced responsiveness cannot be dismissed as fatigue or cleared by a simulator.

stages.title: 規畫再評估
stages.evidence: 安全評估後，學員嘗試把一般濃度曲線當成此人的實際清除速度。
stages.evidenceEn: After safety assessment, a learner treats a generic concentration curve as this person’s actual clearance.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 保留模型假設與病人資料缺漏的標記
choices.en: Label model assumptions and missing patient information

choices.zh: 由畫面曲線推定個人的安全駕車時刻
choices.en: Infer an individual safe-driving time from the plot

stages.reason: 教學曲線未包含個體差異或實測濃度，不能提供駕車許可或處方。
stages.reasonEn: The teaching curve lacks individual variability and measured concentrations; it cannot authorise driving or prescribe.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「由畫面曲線推定個人的安全駕車時刻」。教學曲線未包含個體差異或實測濃度，不能提供駕車許可或處方。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Infer an individual safe-driving time from the plot. The teaching curve lacks individual variability and measured concentrations; it cannot authorise driving or prescribe.

stages.title: 交班與回饋
stages.evidence: 交班產品成分、使用與飲酒時間、反應變化、緊急評估結果及後續用藥審查者。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over ingredients, medicine and alcohol timing, responsiveness changes, assessment results and the medication-review owner.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 只交付最終結論，省略限制與後續負責者
choices.en: Transfer only the conclusion without limitations or follow-up ownership

choices.zh: 交付本案證據、未解問題及具名接手者
choices.en: Transfer the evidence, unresolved questions and named follow-up owner

stages.reason: 交班需保留：交班產品成分、使用與飲酒時間、反應變化、緊急評估結果及後續用藥審查者。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over ingredients, medicine and alcohol timing, responsiveness changes, assessment results and the medication-review owner.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「只交付最終結論，省略限制與後續負責者」。交班需保留：交班產品成分、使用與飲酒時間、反應變化、緊急評估結果及後續用藥審查者。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Transfer only the conclusion without limitations or follow-up ownership. The handover must preserve: Hand over ingredients, medicine and alcohol timing, responsiveness changes, assessment results and the medication-review owner.

learningBoundary.zh: 用於教學推理；數據為虛構，不提供個人處方、真實疫情判定或臨床驗證預測。
learningBoundary.en: For reasoning education; fictional data do not provide prescriptions, real outbreak determinations or clinically validated predictions.

procedures.title: 藥丸變色後的疑慮：成分、劑型與病人感受
procedures.titleEn: A different-looking tablet: ingredients, formulation and experience
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據與系統安全
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence and system safety
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：58 歲患者領到不同廠牌藥品後擔心療效下降，拿來新舊藥盒要求比較。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 58-year-old patient worries that a different manufacturer’s product is weaker and brings both boxes.

stages.title: 釐清問題
stages.evidence: 新舊藥丸顏色不同，標籤上的有效成分相同。
stages.evidenceEn: Tablet colours differ while the labels show the same active ingredient.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 核對產品與核准資訊
choices.en: Verify product and approval information

choices.zh: 先由藥丸外觀決定是否為可替代產品
choices.en: Decide interchangeability from tablet appearance first

stages.reason: 外觀不能單獨判斷替代關係；需確認實際產品，而非僅比較照片。
stages.reasonEn: Appearance alone cannot establish interchangeability; identify actual products rather than comparing photographs.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「顏色不同即可判定成分或療效不同」。外觀不能單獨判斷替代關係；需確認實際產品，而非僅比較照片。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Infer different ingredients or effects from colour alone. Appearance alone cannot establish interchangeability; identify actual products rather than comparing photographs.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 其中一張舊標籤帶有延長釋放字樣，新資料截圖被裁掉了劑型欄。
stages.evidenceEn: An older label indicates extended release, but the new screenshot omits formulation.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 只要有效成分相同就視為完全相同產品
choices.en: Treat the same ingredient as proof of identical products

choices.zh: 補查劑型與釋放特性後請藥師核對
choices.en: Retrieve formulation and release details for pharmacist review

stages.reason: 相同成分不自動證明劑型、強度及使用方式相同；缺漏不能以猜測補上。
stages.reasonEn: The same ingredient does not establish identical formulation, strength or use; do not guess missing details.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「只要有效成分相同就視為完全相同產品」。相同成分不自動證明劑型、強度及使用方式相同；缺漏不能以猜測補上。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Treat the same ingredient as proof of identical products. The same ingredient does not establish identical formulation, strength or use; do not guess missing details.

stages.title: 比較解釋
stages.evidence: 藥師確認是對應的核准學名藥；患者仍說更換後頭暈。
stages.evidenceEn: The pharmacist verifies the approved generic counterpart, but the patient reports new dizziness.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 同時說明核准標準並評估症狀時間與其他變化
choices.en: Explain approval standards and assess symptom timing and other changes

choices.zh: 核准等效就代表個人的任何新症狀都不需理會
choices.en: Dismiss all new symptoms because equivalence is approved

stages.reason: 產品證據與個人症狀評估可並行；也不應未評估就宣稱頭暈必由換藥造成。
stages.reasonEn: Product evidence and symptom assessment can coexist; timing alone also does not prove the switch caused dizziness.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「核准等效就代表個人的任何新症狀都不需理會」。產品證據與個人症狀評估可並行；也不應未評估就宣稱頭暈必由換藥造成。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Dismiss all new symptoms because equivalence is approved. Product evidence and symptom assessment can coexist; timing alone also does not prove the switch caused dizziness.

stages.title: 規畫再評估
stages.evidence: 患者承認因擔心而漏用數次，原先並未告訴團隊。
stages.evidenceEn: The patient reveals several missed administrations because of worry.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 把未改善直接列為學名藥療效失敗
choices.en: Label lack of improvement as generic failure immediately

choices.zh: 以不責備方式記錄實際使用與追蹤目標
choices.en: Document actual use and follow-up goals without blame

stages.reason: 實際使用差異會影響判讀；應先釐清疑慮與障礙，而不是以標籤責備病人。
stages.reasonEn: Differences in actual use affect interpretation; explore concerns and barriers rather than blaming the person.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「把未改善直接列為學名藥療效失敗」。實際使用差異會影響判讀；應先釐清疑慮與障礙，而不是以標籤責備病人。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Label lack of improvement as generic failure immediately. Differences in actual use affect interpretation; explore concerns and barriers rather than blaming the person.

stages.title: 交班與回饋
stages.evidence: 交班已確認的成分與劑型、核准產品核對、症狀時間、漏用紀錄及追蹤負責者。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over confirmed ingredients and formulation, product verification, symptom timing, missed use and follow-up ownership.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 交付本案證據、未解問題及具名接手者
choices.en: Transfer the evidence, unresolved questions and named follow-up owner

choices.zh: 只交付最終結論，省略限制與後續負責者
choices.en: Transfer only the conclusion without limitations or follow-up ownership

stages.reason: 交班需保留：交班已確認的成分與劑型、核准產品核對、症狀時間、漏用紀錄及追蹤負責者。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over confirmed ingredients and formulation, product verification, symptom timing, missed use and follow-up ownership.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「只交付最終結論，省略限制與後續負責者」。交班需保留：交班已確認的成分與劑型、核准產品核對、症狀時間、漏用紀錄及追蹤負責者。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Transfer only the conclusion without limitations or follow-up ownership. The handover must preserve: Hand over confirmed ingredients and formulation, product verification, symptom timing, missed use and follow-up ownership.

learningBoundary.en: For reasoning education; fictional data do not provide prescriptions, real outbreak determinations or clinically validated predictions.

procedures.title: 新藥後皮疹：通報與因果判定分開
procedures.titleEn: Rash after a new medicine: separate reporting from causality
procedures.category: 編者病例：證據與系統安全
procedures.categoryEn: Editorial cases: evidence and system safety
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：39 歲患者開始新藥數日後出現皮疹，同週也有感染症狀；團隊準備安全通報。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 39-year-old develops a rash days after starting a medicine and has infection symptoms during the same week.

stages.title: 釐清問題
stages.evidence: 紀錄只有「上週吃藥後起疹」，缺少開始日與其他產品。
stages.evidenceEn: The note says only “rash after last week’s medicine,” without dates or other products.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 只填新藥商品名就足以完成因果判定
choices.en: Use the new brand name alone to establish causality

choices.zh: 補齊時間線、所有暴露與皮疹描述
choices.en: Complete the timeline, exposures and rash description

stages.reason: 時序與替代解釋影響判讀；通報需要可追溯資訊，不把推測寫成已證實。
stages.reasonEn: Timing and alternative explanations inform assessment; a report needs traceable information without presenting suspicion as proof.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「只填新藥商品名就足以完成因果判定」。時序與替代解釋影響判讀；通報需要可追溯資訊，不把推測寫成已證實。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Use the new brand name alone to establish causality. Timing and alternative explanations inform assessment; a report needs traceable information without presenting suspicion as proof.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 重新訪談出現嘴部黏膜破損及發燒，尚未現場評估。
stages.evidenceEn: Further history reveals mouth lesions and fever without an in-person assessment.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 將警訊交由團隊緊急評估，通報同步準備
choices.en: Escalate red flags for urgent assessment while preparing the report

choices.zh: 為使通報表完整，先等皮疹自行消退
choices.en: Wait for resolution to complete the form first

stages.reason: 安全評估優先於行政完整；本教案不提供重新暴露或自行停換藥的指示。
stages.reasonEn: Safety assessment takes priority over paperwork; the lesson gives no rechallenge or self-directed medication-change instructions.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「為使通報表完整，先等皮疹自行消退」。安全評估優先於行政完整；本教案不提供重新暴露或自行停換藥的指示。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Wait for resolution to complete the form first. Safety assessment takes priority over paperwork; the lesson gives no rechallenge or self-directed medication-change instructions.

stages.title: 比較解釋
stages.evidence: 資料庫搜尋找到 30 筆類似報告，但不知道使用人數或重複報告情形。
stages.evidenceEn: A database search finds 30 similar reports, without exposure totals or duplicate information.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 把 30 筆通報直接當成此藥的發生率
choices.en: Treat 30 reports as the medicine’s incidence rate

choices.zh: 視為需審查的安全訊號，不能直接計算發生率
choices.en: Treat them as a signal needing review, not a calculable incidence

stages.reason: 自發通報缺少完整分母，且可能有選擇性與重複通報；筆數不是風險大小。
stages.reasonEn: Spontaneous reports lack a complete denominator and may involve selection or duplication; counts are not risk estimates.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「把 30 筆通報直接當成此藥的發生率」。自發通報缺少完整分母，且可能有選擇性與重複通報；筆數不是風險大小。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Treat 30 reports as the medicine’s incidence rate. Spontaneous reports lack a complete denominator and may involve selection or duplication; counts are not risk estimates.

stages.title: 規畫再評估
stages.evidence: 患者詢問：送出通報是否代表醫院已證實藥物造成皮疹？
stages.evidenceEn: The patient asks whether reporting means the hospital has proved the medicine caused the rash.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 說明通報疑慮與正式因果評估的差別
choices.en: Explain the distinction between reporting a concern and assessing causality

choices.zh: 為讓患者安心，宣稱通報即等於確定因果
choices.en: Claim reporting itself establishes causality

stages.reason: 清楚表達已知、未知與下一步，可保留安全訊息而不做過度斷言。
stages.reasonEn: Explaining what is known, unknown and next preserves the safety concern without overclaiming.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「為讓患者安心，宣稱通報即等於確定因果」。清楚表達已知、未知與下一步，可保留安全訊息而不做過度斷言。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Claim reporting itself establishes causality. Explaining what is known, unknown and next preserves the safety concern without overclaiming.

stages.title: 交班與回饋
stages.evidence: 交班暴露與皮疹時間、黏膜及發燒警訊、已完成評估、通報編號與因果審查接手者。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over exposure and rash timing, mucosal and fever warnings, completed assessment, report identifier and causality-review owner.
stages.question: 依本階段證據，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported at this stage?

choices.zh: 只交付最終結論，省略限制與後續負責者
choices.en: Transfer only the conclusion without limitations or follow-up ownership

choices.zh: 交付本案證據、未解問題及具名接手者
choices.en: Transfer the evidence, unresolved questions and named follow-up owner

stages.reason: 交班需保留：交班暴露與皮疹時間、黏膜及發燒警訊、已完成評估、通報編號與因果審查接手者。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over exposure and rash timing, mucosal and fever warnings, completed assessment, report identifier and causality-review owner.
stages.pitfall: 避免直接推論「只交付最終結論，省略限制與後續負責者」。交班需保留：交班暴露與皮疹時間、黏膜及發燒警訊、已完成評估、通報編號與因果審查接手者。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Transfer only the conclusion without limitations or follow-up ownership. The handover must preserve: Hand over exposure and rash timing, mucosal and fever warnings, completed assessment, report identifier and causality-review owner.

learningBoundary.zh: 用於教學推理；數據為虛構，不提供個人處方、真實疫情判定或臨床驗證預測。
learningBoundary.en: For reasoning education; fictional data do not provide prescriptions, real outbreak determinations or clinically validated predictions.
